messages:
mike: Quick thread — we need a concise sprint acceptance checklist for enterprise compliance work (audit logs, BYOK/KMS, SOC2 evidence, retention). Goal: clear, testable gates so PM/Eng/Ops/Legal can sign off.

sophia: +1. Keep it to surface-level pass/fail tests. No vague words like "production-ready" — instead list specific test artifacts.

lee: My checklist suggestion: append-only audit stream, exportable evidence pack (with signed manifest), BYOK handshake + restore, and retention enforcement across regions.

mike: Draft checklist below — feedback?

```
- audit_append_only: verified by checksum chain for 7d sample
- export_pack: ndjson + sha256(manifest) + manifest.signed (RSA)
- byok_handshake: key_propogation + export+restore run on tenant {dev,staging,customer-sandbox}
- kms_rotation_test: rotate primary key + verify data decrypts; test manual-escrow restore
- retention_policy: buckets=hot(30d),warm(365d),cold(3650d); RTO/RPO: hot(15m/30s), warm(6h/5m), cold(48h/1h)
- soc2_sample: 3 evidence exports with retrieval timestamps and access-proof logs
- rollout_plan: canary(5%) -> 25% -> 100% with immediate fallback to previous model on fail
```

ops-bot: Note: KMS rotation must be exercised against both AWS-KMS and Vault-backed KMS in staging; include rotation runbook link: <https://internal.redwood/playbooks/kms-rotation>. DB migration required for retention buckets (small metadata backfill) 1:30 maintenance suggested.

legal-sarah: Contract needs: notification to customer if retention >90d default, explicit escrow acceptance criteria, and requirement for signed manifest (hash + signer). I'll add the language.

sophia: Two quick clarifications: (1) who owns the manifest signing key? (2) which tenants for BYOK run?

lee: Manifest signing key: ops will use a rotation-protected service key (not customer keys). BYOK run tenants: dev, staging, 1 customer sandbox (preferably a non-production customer that has signed NDA).

mike: Example curl for export + manifest generation (smoke test):

```
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/audit/export \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant":"t-xyz","from":"2025-01-01T00:00:00Z","to":"2025-01-07T00:00:00Z","format":"ndjson"}' \
  | tee export.ndjson 
  && sha256sum export.ndjson > export.sha256 
  && ./sign-manifest --key /opt/signing/service.key export.sha256 > manifest.signed
```

sophia: Good. Action owners: lee -> implement checksum-chain verification and export tool; ops -> rotation + manifest signer; legal-sarah -> contract snippet; mike -> acceptance doc + smoke test harness.

ops-bot: Reminder: cross-region replication must enforce retention TTLs consistently; file a small infra task to validate.

legal-sarah: I'll draft contract text and post a short PR in 24h. It will include retention change notification window (30 days) and escrow acceptance checklist.

mike: Timeline: run spikes this week, export/restore tests next week, legal sign-off + final acceptance doc by end of sprint. If tests pass on 3 tenants, PM will mark gate = ready.

sophia: I'll publish the acceptance doc once we have test logs. Tagging stakeholders then. :white_check_mark:
